description.en: Agent progress folds into short summaries, code blocks gain highlighting and a copy button, and the message box is redesigned.
description.zh: 智能体进度收起为摘要，代码块支持高亮与复制，输入框焕新。

title.en: A refreshed workspace sidebar and title bar
title.zh: 工作区侧栏与标题栏焕新

title.en: Clearer connection test for relays that only accept coding tools
title.zh: 仅支持编程工具的中转站，连接测试不再误报

description.en: Such an endpoint turns away the direct test, so the result now says it cannot be checked here instead of reporting the key as failed.
description.zh: 这类接口会拒绝直连测试，现在结果会说明无法在此检测，不再显示为密钥校验失败。
